name: yoooni-daily-plugin
description: Yoooni daily-work toolbox: onboarding, SMB share fix, IDEA/Resin setup, daily startup, one-click install & fully-automatic update of the company plugins + MCP, production-log troubleshooting, cross-directory task spaces, and a hook-hit weekly report. Includes a SessionStart auto-update hook.

interface.shortDescription: Yoooni 团队日常工具箱：入职、启动、安装/更新公司套件、生产排障、任务空间。
interface.longDescription: Yoooni 团队日常工作插件，9 个 Skill 覆盖：入职初始化（SVN 拉文档）、SMB 共享访问修复、IDEA/Resin 开发环境搭建、日常启动、一键安装与全自动更新公司插件+MCP、生产日志排障、跨目录任务空间、hook 命中周报；并内置 SessionStart 自动更新 hook（后台 git pull + claude plugin update + 同步命中日志）。Works across Claude Code and Codex.
